adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `parseRefreshTokenResponse`, which unconditionally (i.e., regardless of the `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` branch) mutates the parsed data by setting `refresh_token` to the literal string "refresh_token" when it’s missing (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:25-27). This function is then used in multiple refresh flows (e.g., office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts and zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts). In office365, the returned `.data` is spread into existing stored credentials (`o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`), so if the provider omits `refresh_token` and the schema allows it to be missing, the placeholder will overwrite the real stored refresh token, changing behavior even when sync isn’t enabled.
